function backgroundPositionCase(v) {
  document.body.innerHTML='';document.body.style.cssText='margin:0';document.documentElement.style.fontSize='20px';
  const parent=document.createElement('main');parent.style.fontSize='20px';document.body.append(parent);
  const sheet=document.createElement('style');document.head.append(sheet);
  const e=document.createElement('div');e.id='target';parent.append(e);const s=getComputedStyle(e),checks={};
  const list=(value)=>{const result=[];let depth=0,start=0;for(let i=0;i<value.length;i++){const c=value[i];if(c==='(')depth++;if(c===')')depth--;if(c===','&&depth===0){result.push(value.slice(start,i).trim());start=i+1;}}result.push(value.slice(start).trim());return result;};
  const check=(name,css,x,y,rules='')=>{sheet.textContent=rules;e.style.cssText='width:40px;height:10px;'+css;checks[name]=s.backgroundPositionX===x&&s.backgroundPositionY===y&&s.getPropertyValue('background-position')===list(x).map((a,i)=>a+' '+list(y)[i]).join(', ')&&e.getBoundingClientRect().width===40&&e.getBoundingClientRect().height===10;};
  check('default','','0%','0%');check('center','background-position:center','50%','50%');check('leftTop','background-position:left top','0%','0%');check('rightBottom','background-position:right bottom','100%','100%');
  check('singleVertical','background-position:bottom','50%','100%');check('singleLength',`background-position:${v+3}px`,`${v+3}px`,'50%');
  check('axes','background-position-x:right;background-position-y:bottom','100%','100%');
  check('axisCenter','background-position-x:center;background-position-y:center','50%','50%');
  check('lengths',`background-position:${v+3}px ${v+4}px`,`${v+3}px`,`${v+4}px`);
  check('percentage','background-position:20% 70%','20%','70%');check('negative','background-position:-2px -30%','-2px','-30%');
  check('absolute','background-position:1in 2in','96px','192px');check('em','background-position:1.5em 2em','30px','40px');check('rem','font-size:40px;background-position:1.5rem 2rem','30px','40px');
  check('viewport','background-position-x:1vw;background-position-y:1vh',`${innerWidth/100}px`,`${innerHeight/100}px`);
  check('endLength','background-position:right 2em bottom 3em','calc(100% - 40px)','calc(100% - 60px)');
  check('endPercent','background-position:right 20% bottom 30%','80%','70%');check('startOffsets','background-position:left 2em top 30%','40px','30%');
  check('axisEnd','background-position-x:right 2em;background-position-y:bottom 3px','calc(100% - 40px)','calc(100% - 3px)');
  check('threeHorizontalReverse','background-position:center right 20px','calc(100% - 20px)','50%');
  check('threeVertical','background-position:bottom 30px center','50%','calc(100% - 30px)');
  check('fourReverse','background-position:bottom 30px left 20px','20px','calc(100% - 30px)');
  check('negativeZero','background-position:-0px -0%','0px','0%');
  check('lengthMath','background-position:calc(1em + 2px) calc(2em - 3px)','22px','37px');
  check('mixedMath','background-position:calc(20% + 2em) calc(50% - 3px)','calc(20% + 40px)','calc(50% - 3px)');
  check('endMath','background-position:right calc(20% + 2em) bottom calc(30% - 3px)','calc(80% - 40px)','calc(70% + 3px)');
  check('product','background-position:calc((20% + 1em)*2) 0px','calc(40% + 40px)','0px');
  check('zeroPercentMath','background-position:calc(0% + 2px) calc(20% + 0px)','calc(0% + 2px)','20%');
  check('minimum','background-position:min(1em,30px) min(20%,2em)','20px','min(20%, 40px)');
  check('maximum','background-position:max(1em,30px) max(20%,2em)','30px','max(20%, 40px)');
  check('clamp','background-position:clamp(30px,1em,10px) clamp(10%,2em,60%)','30px','clamp(10%, 40px, 60%)');
  check('nested','background-position:min(20%,max(10%,2em)) 0px','min(20%, max(10%, 40px))','0px');
  check('percentageFunctions','background-position:min(20%,50%) clamp(10%,20%,50%)','min(20%, 50%)','clamp(10%, 20%, 50%)');
  e.style.backgroundPositionX='min(20%,50%)';checks.liveOrigin=s.backgroundPosition==='20% clamp(10%, 20%, 50%)';
  check('directPercentageFunctions','background-position-x:min(20%,50%);background-position-y:clamp(10%,20%,50%)','20%','20%');
  check('layers','background-image:none,none,none;background-position:10px 20px,center bottom','10px, 50%, 10px','20px, 100%, 20px');
  check('differentAxisLists','background-image:none,none,none;background-position-x:10px,20px;background-position-y:30px','10px, 20px, 10px','30px, 30px, 30px');
  check('trimExcess','background-position:10px 20px,center bottom','10px','20px');
  check('variable',`--position:${v+3}px 20%;background-position:var(--position)`,`${v+3}px`,'20%');check('invalidVariable','background-position:var(--missing)','0%','0%');
  check('specificity','','50%','100%','div{background-position:0% 0%}#target{background-position:center bottom}');
  check('sourceOrder','','50%','100%','#target{background-position:0% 0%}#target{background-position:center bottom}');
  check('inlineOrigin','background-position:center bottom','50%','100%','#target{background-position:0% 0%}');
  check('important','background-position:0% 0%','50%','100%','#target{background-position:center bottom!important}');
  check('cascadeLayers','','50%','100%','@layer early,late;@layer early{#target{background-position:0% 0%}}@layer late{div{background-position:center bottom}}');
  sheet.textContent='';parent.style.backgroundPosition='1em 2em';check('notInherited','','0%','0%');check('inherit','font-size:40px;background-position:inherit','20px','40px');check('unset','background-position:unset','0%','0%');check('initial','background-position:initial','0%','0%');
  e.style.cssText='background-position:10px 20px';e.style.backgroundPosition='auto';checks.invalidKeyword=s.backgroundPosition==='10px 20px';e.style.backgroundPosition='left right';checks.invalidPair=s.backgroundPosition==='10px 20px';
  e.style.setProperty('BACKGROUND-POSITION-X','right','important');checks.cssom=s.backgroundPosition==='100% 20px'&&e.style.getPropertyPriority('background-position-x')==='important';
  checks.removal=e.style.removeProperty('background-position-x')==='right'&&s.backgroundPosition==='0% 20px';
  e.style.backgroundPosition='1em 2em';e.style.fontSize='30px';checks.liveFont=s.backgroundPosition==='30px 60px';
  sheet.textContent='#target{background-position:center bottom!important}';checks.liveSheet=s.backgroundPosition==='50% 100%';sheet.textContent='#target{background-position:left top!important}';checks.liveSheetMutation=s.backgroundPosition==='0% 0%';
  e.style.backgroundImage='none,none';checks.liveLayerCount=s.backgroundPosition==='0% 0%, 0% 0%';
  const external=document.createElement('div');external.id='external';parent.append(external);checks.external=getComputedStyle(external).backgroundPosition===`${v+3}px 20%`;
  const throws=(fn,name)=>{try{fn();return false;}catch(e){return e.name===name;}};
  checks.readOnly=throws(()=>{s.backgroundPositionX='none'},'NoModificationAllowedError');checks.priority=s.getPropertyPriority('background-position')==='';checks.uppercase=s.getPropertyValue('BACKGROUND-POSITION')==='0% 0%, 0% 0%';
  checks.enumeration=Array.from({length:s.length},(_,i)=>s.item(i)).filter(name=>name.startsWith('background-position')).join(',')==='background-position';
  e.remove();checks.detached=s.backgroundPosition==='';parent.append(e);checks.reattached=s.backgroundPosition==='0% 0%, 0% 0%';
  sheet.remove();return checks;
}
